DESCRIPTION: A Sennheiser EW-DX receiver (EM 2, EM 2 Dante, EM 4 Dante, firmware 3.0.x or legacy mode) over the Sound Control Protocol on UDP 45: every method of its developer's guide - each channel's name, mute, gain, frequency and warnings, its pack's battery, name, mute and trim, the device's own - and its meters. Four channels described; an EM 2 has two.

GODOT.MODEL: EW-DX EM 2, EM 2 Dante, EM 4 Dante (SSC v1)
SOURCES: Sennheiser, Sound Control Protocol (SSC), Developer's guide for EW-DX (EW-DX EM 2, EM 2 Dante, EM 4 Dante, firmware 3.0.x), publ. 03/2024: the data structure, subscriptions (min, max, count, lifetime), UDP 45, the method list - transcribed as scripts/presets/sources/sennheiser/ewdx-em-ssc-3.0.tsv
cross-read, not copied: bitfocus/companion-module-sennheiser-ewdx (MIT), its help page: legacy mode needed from firmware 4.0.0

visual.DESCRIPTION: Command to start/stop device identification visual (true: start; false: stop; null: read status).

vendor.DESCRIPTION: Command replies "Sennheiser electronic SE & CO KG".

serial.DESCRIPTION: Not yet implemented. Serial no from production.

version.DESCRIPTION: EW-DX EM 2 Dante and EW-DX EM 4 Dante exclusive! Get version of DANTE SW as string value.

netmask.DESCRIPTION: EW-DX EM 2 Dante and EW-DX EM 4 Dante exclusive! Get the current network IPv4 netmask addresses of Dante interfaces [primary, secondary] as array of string values e.g. "255.255.255.0","0.0.0.0".

manual_netmask.DESCRIPTION: EW-DX EM 2 Dante and EW-DX EM 4 Dante exclusive! Set/get manual network IPv4 netmask address of Dante interfaces [primary, secondary] as array of string values e.g. "255.255.255.0","255.255.255.0".

manual_ipaddr.DESCRIPTION: EW-DX EM 2 Dante and EW-DX EM 4 Dante exclusive! Set/get manual network IPv4 IP address of Dante interfaces [primary, secondary] as array of string values e.g. "192.168.1.10","192.168.2.10".

manual_gateway.DESCRIPTION: EW-DX EM 2 Dante and EW-DX EM 4 Dante exclusive! Set/get manual network IPv4 gateway address of Dante interfaces [primary, secondary] as array of string values e.g. "192.168.1.1","192.168.2.1".

ipaddr.DESCRIPTION: EW-DX EM 2 Dante and EW-DX EM 4 Dante exclusive! Get the current network IPv4 IP addresses of Dante interfaces [primary, secondary] as array of string values e.g. "192.168.1.10","0.0.0.0".

gateway.DESCRIPTION: EW-DX EM 2 Dante and EW-DX EM 4 Dante exclusive! Get the current network IPv4 gateway addresses of Dante interfaces [primary, secondary] as array of string values e.g. "192.168.1.1","0.0.0.0".

auto.DESCRIPTION: EW-DX EM 2 Dante and EW-DX EM 4 Dante exclusive! Set/read network mode of Dante interfaces [primary, secondary] -> true: Auto-IP/DHCP; false: Manual.

macs.DESCRIPTION: EW-DX EM 2 Dante and EW-DX EM 4 Dante exclusive! Get DANTE MAC addresses as array of string values.

interfaces.DESCRIPTION: EW-DX EM 2 Dante and EW-DX EM 4 Dante exclusive! Get DANTE interfaces names as array of string values.

interface_mapping.DESCRIPTION: EW-DX EM 2 Dante and EW-DX EM 4 Dante exclusive! Set/get the dante interface or port mapping configuration ID as string.

auto.DESCRIPTION: Command to configure ip settings automatically (true: use DHCP and ZeroConf (Auto-IP); false: set ip address/netmask/gateway manually).

mdns.DESCRIPTION: Command to enable, disable or read mdns state.

preset_spacing.DESCRIPTION: get device preset spacing in kHz depending on if LD mode is active or not.

time.DESCRIPTION: Current absolute clock value (in seconds) of the device since 2000-01-01T00:00:00+0000 UTC.

restore.DESCRIPTION: Command to restore device default settings. Valid options: "FACTORY_DEFAULTS" (restore all factory defaults), "AUDIO_DEFAULTS" (restore audio defaults only).

remote_access.DESCRIPTION: You can store a 15 characters long string here. It will not be stored persistently and will be cleared after 2 minutes!

name.DESCRIPTION: Command to set or read device name. At most 18 characters.

lock.DESCRIPTION: Set EW-DX EM device keys locked (true) / unlocked (false)

location.DESCRIPTION: Command to set or read device location. At most 400 characters.

link_density_mode.DESCRIPTION: Switch RF transmission link density mode on if true is specified or off (standard mode) if false is specified. Note: This command leads to a device reboot!

language.DESCRIPTION: List of supported languages. English only = ["en_GB"].

frequency_ranges.DESCRIPTION: Command to read receiver device frequency ranges. frequency_code.DESCRIPTION: Command to read receiver device frequency range code.

brightness.DESCRIPTION: Brightness in percent index (1..5) corrresponds to (20%..100%).
